title: Developers Turned Claude Into a 24/7 Trading Desk
tldr: Developers now run Claude as a scheduled agent that researches markets, trades through a broker, and logs every decision without being clicked.
Broker access comes in three graded tiers — read-only, human-approved, or a walled autonomous sub-account — and a hard-coded daily loss limit halts it automatically.
